test_groups: fixed 1232 groups in data/manifests/compphish_v4_random_cue_splits.csv; originally drawn from untouched original-train groups
train_development_source: all non-test groups; fresh training excludes every reserved test group
threshold_rule: lowest score threshold achieving empirical development benign FPR <= 0.02; positive iff score >= threshold

arms.F: first factual feature in seeded preassigned family
arms.R: uniform factual mutable same-family feature other than M; deterministic per serial; starts without an alternative are ineligible for primary M-R
arms.M: eligible same-family factual feature with greatest positive score reduction under train-only median/mode replacement, tie by registry order

primary.population: initially detected test phishing starts with M and a distinct factual mutable same-family random alternative
primary.inference: row-weighted paired difference; 10000 connected-group bootstrap replicates; two-sided 97.5% intervals for two detector contrasts, Bonferroni familywise 5%

secondary: M-F at primary budget; descriptive V/F/R/M rates and 10/20/40-query sensitivity on identical matched rows
endpoint: abstract feature-vector negative prediction flip; not webpage or URL feasibility
test_evaluation: one run only after freeze hash verification; no retuning or rerun
